Currency.description: A currency: what it is called, its symbol, how many minor units make one major unit, and which side of an amount the symbol is written on. Display data only: no amount changes with any of it.

exponent.description: How many digits of an amount are minor units, from 0 to 4: 2 means 250 is shown as 2.50 (ISO 4217's minor-unit column: JPY 0, USD 2, KWD 3, CLF 4).

name.description: Its name, such as "mark" or "shell": 1 to 64 bytes of text with no control characters.

symbol.description: Its symbol, such as "M" or "sh": 1 to 8 bytes, no control characters, no whitespace at either end.

symbol_at.description: Where the symbol is written: `before` the amount ($2.50) or `after` it (3 cr).

CurrencyName.description: A currency's name: 1 to 64 bytes of text, no control characters.

CurrencySymbol.description: A currency's symbol: 1 to 8 bytes, no control characters, no whitespace at either end.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

Exponent.description: How many digits of an amount are minor units: 0 to 4.

HappeningKindId.description: A kind's id: `market-day`, `festival`. The identifier rule of `contracts` (lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`, neither first nor last a separator), at most [`KIND_ID_MAX_BYTES`].

Permille.description: A price multiplier per mille, 100 … 10 000: 900 is 10 % off, 1 500 half as much again.

PriceModifier.description: While a happening of kind `during` runs, the shop at `shop` multiplies its prices by `permille`. `P` is how the shop's place is named: its key in the file, its id once seeded.

during.description: The happening kind it applies during, by id; matched, never interpreted.

permille.description: The price multiplier per mille, 100 to 10000: 900 is 10 % off.

SymbolAt.description: Which side of an amount a currency's symbol is written on.

currency.description: The world's one currency, in which every wallet, price and reference value is counted. Required: a world that enables economy and authors any amount must say what its amounts are.

price_modifiers.description: Which shops change their prices while which happenings run: at most 32, each (during, shop) once.
